$comment: Generated from lib/tutors/schemas.ts by `npm run generate:schemas` — do not edit by hand.
title: Tutor YAML
description: Schema for a tutor definition: an AI chat tutor with an assembled system prompt.

id.description: Short machine-readable tutor id, e.g. fractions-de.

title.description: Optional greeting shown to students on the empty chat instead of the default welcome message.

description.description: Short description of what this tutor does. Shown to students below the welcome greeting.

exampleQuestions.description: Optional example questions shown to students below the description on the empty chat. Clicking one puts the question text into the chat input. At most 5 are shown; with more, a random 5 are picked per page load.

anonymous.description: Chats are anonymous by default: no link between the signed-in student and their chat is stored. Set to false to record which student each chat belongs to.

tools.description: Optional built-in tools the tutor's model may call (e.g. random_number). Off by default; mention enabled tools in tutor_instructions so the model uses them.

title.description: Short clickable label shown on the welcome screen.

question.description: Full question text. Shown as a tooltip and placed into the chat input on click.

exampleQuestion.description: An example question shown on the welcome screen.

provider.description: The LLM provider serving the model. For Azure Foundry, model is the deployment name.

reasoning.description: Optional reasoning effort for reasoning models. Not every model accepts every level. Omit to let the model decide (the parameter is then not sent); "none" instead turns a reasoning model off.

imageInput.description: Image uploads are enabled by default. Set to false to hide the upload UI for text-only tutors or non-vision-capable models.

llm.description: The model and provider that back this tutor.

tutorToolName.description: Name of a built-in tutor tool.

fragment_files.description: Optional fragment libraries used by this tutor.

text_files.description: Optional plain-text files (markdown / source) embedded verbatim via {{file "alias"}} markers.

tutor_instructions.description: The tutor's system prompt. When any fragment_files or text_files are declared this is a Handlebars template: place fragments inline with {{fragment "alias.id" key="v"}} markers and embed text files with {{file "alias"}} (optionally {{file "alias" from=10 to=40}} for a line range; escape a literal {{ as \{{). For single-file tutors it is the whole prompt.

prompt.description: The tutor system prompt: a host template with inline fragment markers.

id.description: Local alias for this library, used before the dot in `{{fragment "alias.id"}}`. Must not contain a dot.

url.description: HTTP(S) URL or relative path to the fragment library.

fragmentFileRef.description: A reference to a fragment library by alias + URL.

id.description: Local alias for this text file, used in `{{file "alias"}}`. Must not contain a dot.

url.description: HTTP(S) URL or relative path to the plain-text file.

textFileRef.description: A reference to a plain-text file (markdown / source) by alias + URL.
